map.矩形梁受弯配筋: Flexural reinforcement of a rectangular beam
map.属超筋，破坏呈脆性不安全；应加大截面、提高混凝土等级或改双筋（加受压筋）受压区高: The section is over-reinforced and would fail in a brittle, unsafe manner. Enlarge the section, raise the concrete grade, or switch to a doubly reinforced section with compression steel to control the depth of the compression zone. Adding bottom steel alone is not enough.
map.最小配筋率为什么有？: Why is there a minimum reinforcement ratio?
map.防止少筋梁一裂即断（脆性），ρ≥ρmin（约 0.2%）；配筋率过低按素混凝土梁: It prevents a lightly reinforced beam from snapping as soon as it cracks (brittle failure). ρ ≥ ρmin (about 0.2%). Below that ratio, treating the member as plain concrete would in fact be more economical.

map.单筋矩形梁正截面：h₀ = h − a_s（mm，弯矩 M ×10⁶ 化 N·m: Singly reinforced rectangular beam: h₀ = h − a_s (mm; M ×10⁶ gives N·mm, α₁ = 1.0); α_s = M ÷ (α₁·f_c·b·h₀²); ξ = 1 − √(1−2α_s); tension steel A_s = ξ·α₁·f_c·b·h₀ ÷ f_y (mm²); reinforcement ratio ρ = A_s ÷ (b·h₀) × 100 (%). Validation: M, b, h₀, f_c and f_y must be > 0, otherwise the tool shows “Please enter valid section and internal-force parameters.” Criterion: α_s > ξ_b(1−0.5ξ_b) is flagged as over-reinforced (ξ_b = 0.8/[1+f_y/(2×10⁵×0.0033)], GB 50010-2010 Eqs. 6.2.7/6.2.10; about 0.384 for HRB400), with the message “enlarge the section or use a doubly reinforced section.” Serviceability crack width (GB 50010-2010 Eq. 7.1.2): σ_s = M_k ÷ (0.87·h₀·A_s); ψ = 1.1 − 0.65·f_tk ÷ (ρ_te·σ_s) (clamped to 0.2 ≤ ψ ≤ 1.0); ρ_te = A_s ÷ A_te (for a rectangular flexural member A_te = 0.5·b·h, and ρ_te is taken as 0.01 when below 0.01); d_eq = Σ(n_i·d_i²) ÷ Σ(n_i·ν_i·d_i) (ν = 1.0 for ribbed bars, 0.7 for plain bars); w_max = α_cr·ψ·σ_s/E_s·(1.9c + 0.08·d_eq/ρ_te), with α_cr = 1.9 for flexure and E_s = 2×10⁵ MPa; the result is compared with the grade-3 0.3 mm limit (grade 2 0.2 mm, grade 1 0.1 mm / prestressed) in GB 50010-2010 Table 3.3.1. Cracking check: first compute M_cr = f_tk·W_0 per 7.1.1 (W_0 = b·h²/6, without the plasticity influence factor γ, on the safe side); when M_k ≤ M_cr the member is uncracked, so ψ is not applicable and w_max = 0; only when M_k > M_cr does Eq. 7.1.2 apply.
map.a_s 受拉钢筋合力点至受拉边缘距离 (mm): a_s — distance from the tension edge to the centroid of tension steel (mm)
map.f_tk 混凝土抗拉强度标准值 (MPa): f_tk — characteristic tensile strength of concrete (MPa)
map.三级裂缝 0.3mm；c 为保护层厚度，a_s 为受拉钢筋合力点至受拉边缘距离，: Grade-3 limit 0.3 mm; c is the cover thickness and a_s is the distance from the tension edge to the rebar centroid — different quantities
map.c 为保护层厚度（钢筋外边缘至混凝土表面），a_s 为受拉钢筋合力点至受拉边缘距: c is the cover thickness (from the bar's outer surface to the concrete face); a_s is the distance from the tension edge to the centroid of the tension steel. They are different quantities: h₀ = h − a_s, so c must not be used in place of a_s (single row a_s is usually 35–40 mm, double row 60–70 mm).
map.裂缝宽度：先按 M_cr = f_tk·W_0（W_0 = b·h²/6，GB: Crack width: first compute M_cr = f_tk·W_0 (W_0 = b·h²/6, GB 50010-2010 7.1.1) and check M_k ≤ M_cr; when uncracked, ψ is not applicable and w_max = 0. Once cracked, σ_s = M_k/(0.87·h₀·A_s), ψ is clamped to 0.2–1.0, ρ_te = A_s/(0.5·b·h) but not less than 0.01, and w_max is compared with the grade-3 limit of 0.3 mm (GB 50010-2010 Eq. 7.1.2 and Table 3.3.1).
map.裂缝宽度：按 GB 50010-2010 式 7.1.2 由 M_k、A_s、f: Crack width: compute w_max from M_k, A_s, f_tk, d_eq and c per GB 50010-2010 Eq. 7.1.2, then compare with the grade-3 0.3 mm limit in Table 3.3.1. Before that, check cracking with M_cr = f_tk·W_0 per 7.1.1: when M_k ≤ M_cr, ψ is not applicable and w_max is recorded as 0. Note that c (cover thickness) and a_s (distance to the steel centroid) are different quantities and must not be confused.
map.c 和 a_s 是一回事吗？: Are c and a_s the same thing?
map.不是。c 是保护层厚度（钢筋外边缘至混凝土表面），a_s 是受拉钢筋合力点至受拉: No. c is the cover thickness (from the bar's outer surface to the concrete face), while a_s is the distance from the tension edge to the centroid of the tension steel. h₀ = h − a_s, so treating c as a_s would overestimate h₀ and underestimate the required steel. A single-row beam usually takes a_s = 35–40 mm and a double row 60–70 mm.
